topic.title: Housing Delivery Test / Measurement / Action Plans
topic.source_contract: published measurement, homes required, homes delivered, applicable years, adjustments, result percentage, policy consequence, action-plan trigger, reasons for under-delivery, measures, ownership, milestones, annual refresh and observed delivery evidence

scope_guards: An HDT result is an authority-level measure, not a parcel score.
An action plan is not evidence that its measures have been delivered.
A planning permission count is not the HDT homes-delivered figure.
Proposed interventions are not completed homes.
A prior-year result is not assumed current.
An action-plan milestone is not an observed outcome.
Policy consequences do not prove a specific site is deliverable.
No score or promotion is written without current measurement and site-specific delivery evidence.
